title: "If you control a facedown card, deal 4 to it instead" clause is not implemented
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/monster-harpoon.ts:4-16 has no abilities field at all (only rulesText). The parsed data in /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/unl.json:706-721 encodes the effect as a flat {type:"damage", amount:2, target:{type:"unit"}} with no conditional for "if you control a facedown card, deal 4 instead". No engine-side override for unl-014-219 exists (grep of riftbound-engine/src and server.ts returns nothing). So the facedown-conditional 4-damage clause is unimplemented; Monster Harpoon always deals 2.
observed: Fight or Flight was hidden facedown at player-1-bf-ogn-276-298 (zone facedown-*, meta.hidden=true, controller player-1); Monster Harpoon then resolved for only 2 damage on Vanguard Attendant (meta.damage=2). Chain item effect was a flat {type:damage, amount:2, target:{unit, battlefield}} with no facedown conditional; the parsed ability in unl.json likewise has only {damage 2}.

history.note: already fixed: explicit conditional abilities with count of friendly facedown cards; unl-014-219.test.ts green (2 vs 4, enemy facedown excluded)

resolution.note: already fixed: explicit conditional abilities with count of friendly facedown cards; unl-014-219.test.ts green (2 vs 4, enemy facedown excluded)
